explication: Midscene is a vision-driven GUI automation agent and E2E testing toolkit for web, mobile, and desktop. The main workflow is a user’s natural-language task entering an Agent, which plans and executes visual actions through a platform integration, checks the visible result, and produces observable execution data for reports. Distinct supporting branches cover declarative YAML tests and custom Nodes, interactive reports, and the Playground. Several links use README-level documentation because the sampled excerpts do not expose their runtime wiring.
